newsitem.title: CHINA: China inks $10 bln in overseas engineering deals.
newsitem.headline: China inks $10 bln in overseas engineering deals.

text.p: China has signed contracts worth a record $10 billion this year to undertake overseas engineering projects and contracted labour, up from $9.2 billion last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.

"Business in the sector has been on a steady increase since the beginning of this year," Zhou Ping, a division deputy director at the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, was quoted as saying.
More contracts were expected to be signed before the end of the year, Zhou said.
At the end of October, 287,000 Chinese construction workers were sent overseas, 33,000 more than a year ago, Xinhua said but gave no further details.
